summary: George Russell's pole position sets up a direct Mercedes challenge to championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who crashes back to 16th and faces a recovery mission on Baku's unforgiving street circuit. McLaren arrives in crisis mode after Lando Norris reported the team running "miles off" pace in practice, threatening to cede ground to rivals in the constructors' battle. A strong result here could extend Antonelli's title lead despite his qualifying disaster, or hand Russell and Mercedes a momentum shift with the grid reshuffled by the crash.
